caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of a grid of 6 rows and 6 columns, totaling 36 squares. Each square contains a circular pattern with a star-like design inside, featuring pointed triangular shapes radiating outward from a smaller central circle. The squares alternate in shades of red, pink, and peach, while the circular star designs inside each square are primarily white with red and pink accents. The squares are outlined and separated by sashing in a pale gray color, which also forms a border around the entire quilt. The outermost edge of the quilt is lined with a thin green border. The background outside the quilt is a plain beige. The patterns within the star designs include alternating colors that mirror the main color of each square, with internal geometric shapes and lines. The drawing is executed with clear lines and shaded with watercolor-style coloring.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
